summary: Learn from validated runtime errors and select relevant standards

delivery.outcome: Expose bounded, effect-free runtime error feedback and evidence-bound standard selection for configuration, capsules and URI processes. Parent PLF-3000 retains controlled remediation execution and cross-project rollout.
nonGoals: No executing commands, adopting standards or promoting conformance from log contents
No edits to foreign ticket-050 source classification or Willmux238 UI
No fabricated runtime success or widened effect permissions

architecture.decision: Extend the registered standards and deterministic capability rules. Add python -m wellman.runtime_feedback: bounded explicit pinned logs contract and data-only code-to-standard routing; canonical event/hash-chain checks; exact event replay deduplication; stable recurrence groups; remediation remains unverified until protected verification. Reports remain advisory and never execute instructions or assert source conformance.
interfaceChanges: python -m wellman.runtime_feedback explicit bounded observation CLI
architecture.rollback: Protected revert of additive module and registry entries; preserve external diagnostic snapshots.

validation.evidence: Known/unknown capability selection, stale/partial refusal, malformed logs, digest/chain tampering, replay, recurrence and no-effect feedback.
Full regressions, governance and independently approved exact-head publication.
Actual error counts and limitations without raw sensitive output; installed merged tool canary.
